name: Skyworth Coocaa K3 Pro 90P3D Max (8R145_P3DM, Realtek RTD2885N), China market
warnings: Comment out any line you want to keep.  ⚠ CRITICAL: NEVER disable com.tianci.movieplatform (the Coocaa launcher).

The 8R145 boot flow hard-depends on it: disabling it hangs the TV on the COOCAA logo, the remote becomes unresponsive, and the only recovery is a factory reset from recovery mode (verified the hard way).

The firmware never broadcasts standard boot events (BOOT_COMPLETED, QUICKBOOT_POWERON) to third-party apps, so auto-start on boot is not possible without root. 5. "Boot source" is also hard-coded: "Signal source" on boot launches com.skyworth.tv (TV app) via firmware logic - there is no app-selection option.
